name: Железная стена
subject: ONE modular defensive IRON WALL section. Thick dark-blue iron core, three broad overlapping armor plate courses on both sides, very large square rivets, short chunky square thorns fixed on plates, two rear-side support buttresses and three squared crenellation teeth along top. Narrow structural gray stone footing ONLY as part of wall construction, no terrain/pedestal. Muted silver cut edges, slate/navy iron, restrained bronze hardware. Strong rectangular armored silhouette.
caption: Пять ракурсов одной существующей постройки. Крупные воксели; без ландшафта, внешней подставки и подписей.
